change.hypothesis: At fixed 1500 Adam updates and learning rate 1e-4, scale training labels by training-only standard deviation and restore scores to return units. Test whether raw-scale optimization explains remaining excess MSE; sorting evidence is evaluated separately.

decision.promotion: No promotion from MSE alone; paired dates, other seeds and return/turnover tradeoffs required.
decision.scale_diagnostic: Validation MSE relative to training-mean constant must fall below one in both windows to count as resolving excess squared error.
decision.screen: Replicate seeds 29 and 47 only if candidate RankIC and long-short mean do not decline in both research periods; otherwise record mixed or failed evidence and retain control for subsequent research.
